subject: Encryption + Audit Log + SSO deep-dive — scheduling for Crescent Health
messages:
From: Anna Bowers <anna.bowers@crescenthealth.com>

Subject: Security architecture review request — encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. We’re finalizing our vendor security assessments for the quarter and would like to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on encryption (at-rest and in-transit), audit logging and retention, and SSO integration options (SAML + OIDC). Crescent Health’s security team will attend and procurement may join for contract/retention questions.

Goal: 60-minute call where we can validate evidence for SOC 2 items and cover any gaps.

Attendees we expect on our side: Anna Bowers (InfoSec), Mike Chen (CTO), and a procurement representative.

I’ve attached our current security questionnaire for context. Could you propose 2-3 slots next week? Prefer mornings PST.

Thanks,
Anna

[Attachment: Crescent_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf]

--
Anna Bowers
Security Lead, Crescent Health

Anna — thanks for the questionnaire and the context. We’d be happy to run the deep-dive.

Proposed slots (all PST, 60 minutes):
- Tue 2026-11-30 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-11-30 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2026-12-01 09:00–10:00

I’ve looped in Rishi (platform/security) to cover audit log retention and access controls, and Dev (infra) for encryption and key management. Marissa will provide architecture diagrams and SOC 2 evidence mapping.

Attached: Redwood SOC 2 evidence checklist to help us map your questionnaire to concrete evidence artifacts. If you can flag the items you care about most, we’ll prepare the evidence and short demos (no production data will be used).

Agenda suggestion (we can tweak):
1) 10m intro & scope
2) 20m encryption & key management (Dev)
3) 15m audit logs, retention, access controls (Rishi)
4) 10m SSO options + integration checklist (Marissa)
5) 5m next steps & evidence handoff

Thanks — I’ll hold the first slot tentatively until we confirm.

[Attachment: redwood_soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx]

Best,

On Wed 9am sounds great if that works for your team.
